detect_faces_in_image: detect faces in an RGB image using face_recognition and MTCNN models and label known faces
encode_faces_from_directory: encode all face images in a directory into face encodings for later recognition
get_facenet_boxes: get face bounding boxes from an image using the MTCNN detector from facenet_pytorch
check_bbox_overlap: check if two bounding boxes with coordinates overlap using the overlap static method
get_union_of_boxes: get the union of two sets of bounding boxes by filtering out overlapping boxes
